item.title: Kacey Musgraves, Eric Church, ‘Landman’ & More to Be Saluted at 2026 ACM Honors: Full List
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest country music update. We've got some exciting news to share with you today. The 19th Academy of Country Music Honors is just around the corner, and we can't wait to tell you who's being recognized this year.
The event, set for August 19th at The Pinnacle in Nashville, will salute some of the biggest names in country music, including Kacey Musgraves, Eric Church, and Bill Anderson. You'll also see industry players like Leslie Fram, Mike Curb, and Scott Zolke being honored for their behind-the-scenes work.
But that's not all - the legendary Carter Family will receive a posthumous award, as will songwriter Brett James. And, Europe's biggest country music festival, C2C: Country to Country, will also be recognized.
[Short music break]
Host: "Now, let's talk about the hosts and performers. Four-time ACM Award winner Carly Pearce is back for the sixth year, and she'll be joined by three-time ACM Award winner Parker McCollum, who's cohosting for the first time. We'll have to wait a little longer to find out who's performing and presenting, but trust us, it'll be worth it.
Tickets go on sale for ACM A-List subscribers and members on June 24th, and to the general public on June 26th through AXS. Don't miss your chance to be a part of this special night.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for now. We can't wait to see who else will be honored at the 19th Academy of Country Music Honors. Stay tuned for more updates, and we'll catch you on the next one."
